note: Marion County KY has no county zoning layer found. The only zoning for the county seat, City of Lebanon, is a static PDF map (LTADD 2017, not legally recorded), with no ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Marion County or Lebanon zoning returned no queryable district layer; the BRADD and KyGovMaps portals had no zoning layer for the county. Third-party sites (zoneomics, acres, regrid) are not official sources.
